answer_1.quote: We proposed a novel model for contextual response generation in multi-turn dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We mainly used the automatic metrics using the DIALOG-EVAL repository, it contains 17 different metrics, but we measure only a few metrics to facilitate the comparison with the published baselines results.

answer_4.quote: We picked 500 dialogues from the test set and asked 3 native speakers for their judgement.
answer_4.guideline: In the first setting, we asked judges to pick the better response among the one generated by our model and a baseline model (Pre-Trained GPT2) based on various criteria like answerability and semantics. In the second setting, in case of multi-turn we used 200 simulated conversations between RL agent and a user model to judge the whole conversation for responses uttered by agent.
